data.narrative: Completed Module 5 Iteration Patterns - chose restart-early strategy with two-iteration threshold. Iteration log: Round 1 (2,3) restart on structural flaw, Round 2 (4,2) refine, Round 3 (4,3) refine, Round 4 (4,4) ship. WebSocket activity feed with pub/sub architecture, connection handling, reconnection with event replay shipped in 4 iterations. Learned surface vs structural distinction, two-iteration rule, context pollution, quality trajectory tracking.

dimension_scores.observation: Restart prompt incorporated everything learned: architectural approach that worked (pub/sub, service-layer events), specific requirements (reconnection, event filtering), explicit constraints preventing failure modes (heartbeat must use WebSocket ping/pong, not application-level messages).
dimension_scores.evidence: Restart prompt: 'Requirements for WebSocket connection lifecycle: Connection authenticate via token, Heartbeat use WebSocket ping/pong frames every 30s NOT application-level messages, Events delivered as JSON data frames, Disconnection server-side cleanup, Reconnection client provides timestamp server replays missed events. IMPORTANT: heartbeat and events MUST use separate WebSocket frame types.'

dimension_scores.observation: Tracked iteration quality with structural and surface scores. Identified regression in Round 3 (connection broke). Diagnosed as context pollution - agent optimized for latest instruction at expense of earlier achievement. Chose restart instead of further refinement. Quality trajectory analysis showed healthy upward convergence after restart.
dimension_scores.evidence: iteration-log.md: 'Round 1 (2,3) restart - database-trigger architectural flaw. Round 2 (4,2) refine - correct pub/sub architecture incomplete implementation. Round 3 (4,3) refine - connection handling improved. Round 4 (4,4) ship - WebSocket with reconnection and event replay.'

dimension_scores.observation: Two-iteration rule applied - restarted when structural <3, refined when >=3. Avoided context pollution spiral by restarting on structural flaw. Shipped working WebSocket activity feed in 4 iterations within budget. Quality trajectory: structural held steady (4), surface improved (2->3->4). No wasted iterations on structural problems.
dimension_scores.evidence: iteration-log.md: 'Decision: restart when structural <3. Refine when structural >=3. Round 1 structural 2 triggered restart. Rounds 2-4 structural 4 allowed refinement. Final output structural 4 surface 4.'

dimension_scores.observation: Chose restart-early strategy over refine-first. Given 30-minute constraint for 47 modules, cannot afford wasted iterations on broken structures. Restart cost: re-prompt from clean conversation keeps learnings - not actually expensive. Refining broken structure cost: each iteration takes review time, polluted context produces worse output. Two wasted iterations cost more than one restart. Restart-early prevented spirals.
dimension_scores.evidence: Decision: 'Restart-early with two-iteration mindset. If first output has structural issues, restart immediately. Only refine for surface-level fixes. Given time constraint, cannot afford wasted iterations on broken structures. Real cost of restart: re-prompt from clean conversation - keeps learnings, not actually expensive.'

dimension_scores.observation: Shipped working WebSocket activity feed with pub/sub architecture, service-layer events, team-scoped channels, connection handling, disconnection cleanup, reconnection with event replay. Functional verification passed: connection succeeds, event delivery works, disconnection cleans up, reconnection resubscribes and replays events. Quality: structural 4, surface 4. Production-ready within 4-iteration budget.
dimension_scores.evidence: iteration-log.md: 'Final Round 4: structural 4, surface 4. Correct pub/sub architecture with service-layer events, WebSocket with reconnection and heartbeat, team-scoped channels. Decision: ship.'

strengths: Two-iteration rule prevented context pollution spiral

public_evidence.ability: Iterative refinement with AI agents - distinguishing surface vs structural issues, applying two-iteration rule, avoiding context pollution spirals
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates critical AI engineering skill - disciplined iteration with quality tracking. Knowing when to refine vs restart prevents wasted time and context pollution. Two-iteration rule is data-driven decision making, not guesswork. Ships working features within iteration budget while avoiding spirals.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Reflection: 'Surface issues: expression problems (naming, error handling gaps, configuration). Structural issues: wrong approach (wrong transport mechanism, wrong storage model, wrong architectural boundary). If fixing issue requires rethinking other parts, it is structural.'

Reflection: 'If quality not converging after 2 refinements, restart. Limits damage of wrong call when not confident distinguishing surface vs structural. Gives room for genuine surface fixes while cutting spirals.'

Reflection: 'Accumulated conversation tokens cause agent to compromise between all requests instead of implementing what is needed. Later iterations can break previously working features. Fresh conversations produce cleaner output.'
